summary: Check domain and social handle availability, and monitor taken handles to grab them when they drop.
offersHint: Check domain and social handle availability, and monitor taken handles to grab them when they drop. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://namesniper.pro/mcp · Packages: npm:namesniper-mcp

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_check
toolsPreview.description: Check brand name availability across domains and social media platforms, with brand score and trademark analysis. Without an API key, trademark screening is skipped and Instagram/TikTok/X return best-effort HTTP confidence; a paid API key unlocks verified accuracy on those platforms plus trademark screening.

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_check_domains
toolsPreview.description: Check domain name availability across multiple TLDs

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_check_social
toolsPreview.description: Check username availability across social media platforms. Without an API key, Instagram, TikTok, and X/Twitter return best-effort HTTP confidence; a paid API key unlocks verified accuracy on those platforms. Each result includes a confidence score (0-1).

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_generate
toolsPreview.description: Generate brand name suggestions using AI based on a business description

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_trademark
toolsPreview.description: Screen a brand name for trademark conflicts via USPTO database

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_alternatives
toolsPreview.description: Generate alternative brand name variations with prefixes, suffixes, and creative patterns

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_watch
toolsPreview.description: Start monitoring a username across platforms and get notified the moment it frees up or drops, so the user can claim it before anyone else. Requires a paid API key (Pro or Business).

toolsPreview.name: namesniper_watches
toolsPreview.description: List all currently monitored handles and their status.
